items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Sees Fresh Partner Tools Push Agentic AI Into Enterprise Workflows
items.summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) is seeing its agentic AI platform extended by third parties through fresh tools and partner programs in 2026. Copado has launched Agentia Headless to let governed AI agents operate directly inside Salesforce development environments used by engineering teams. Brillio has joined Salesforce's Forward Deployed Engineering Partner Network to help enterprises move agentic AI projects into broader production use.
